name: Lightfoot Halfling
description: As a lightfoot halfling, you can easily hide from notice, even using other people as cover. You're inclined to be affable and get along well with others. Lightfoots are more prone to wanderlust than other halflings, and often dwell alongside other races or take up a nomadic life.

features.name: Age
features.description: A halfling reaches adulthood at the age of 20 and generally lives into the middle of his or her second century.
features.snippet: Halflings reach adulthood at 20 and generally live into the middle of their second century.

features.name: Size
features.description: Halflings average about 3 feet tall and weigh about 40 pounds. Your size is Small.

features.name: Speed
features.description: Your base walking speed is 25 feet.
features.snippet: Your base walking speed is 25 feet.

features.name: Halfling Luck
features.description: When you roll a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die. You must use the new result, even if it is a 1.
features.snippet: When you roll a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new result.

features.name: Wanderlust
features.description: At the end of a long rest, you gain Heroic Inspiration if you rested in a completely new and unique location. You and the DM determine when this happens.
features.snippet: At the end of a long rest, you gain Heroic Inspiration if you rested in a completely new and unique location.

features.name: Languages
features.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Halfling.
features.snippet: You can speak, read, and write Common and Halfling.
